video_meta.title: Are Men REALLY Better Drivers Than Women? (The Data)
video_meta.description: We analyze the classic driving debate using real crash statistics, insurance data, and behavioral science. Who actually drives safer? The answer might surprise you! #driving #carfacts #mythbusters #drivingstats #facts

Characters are drawn in a simple, minimalist stick-figure-person style with details, round white heads, small dot eyes, expressive exaggerated faces. Highly detailed crosshatched background.
